name: synthetic-dataflow-bigquery
description: Generate fictitious-but-realistic synthetic rows for a BigQuery table via Apache Beam + L4 GPU + Gemma 4. See docs/CICD.md.

parameters.name: ddl_uri
parameters.label: DDL JSON URI
parameters.helpText: gs:// path to the _ddl.json produced by scripts/extract_ddl.py. Optional; empty/omitted = live INFORMATION_SCHEMA extraction from reference_table.

parameters.name: reference_table
parameters.label: Reference table FQN
parameters.helpText: Source BigQuery table for live SELECT reference rows. project.dataset.table.

parameters.name: reference_rows_limit
parameters.label: Reference rows LIMIT
parameters.helpText: Cap on rows pulled by SELECT ... LIMIT N. Default 10000.

parameters.name: landing_table
parameters.label: Landing table FQN
parameters.helpText: Destination BigQuery table for valid synthetic rows. project.dataset.table.

parameters.name: dlq_table
parameters.label: DLQ table FQN
parameters.helpText: Destination BigQuery table for dead-lettered rows. project.dataset.table.

parameters.name: num_rows
parameters.label: Number of synthetic rows to generate
parameters.helpText: Positive integer.

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.label: Batch size per generate_batch call
parameters.helpText: Records per LLM batch. Default 16.

parameters.name: similarity
parameters.label: Similarity to reference (0.0–1.0)
parameters.helpText: 0=pure random within schema, 1=mimic reference closely. Default 0.5.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.label: Run ID
parameters.helpText: Unique identifier propagated to validation_runs and reference_digest provenance.

parameters.name: identity_cols
parameters.label: Identity columns
parameters.helpText: Comma-separated per-row-unique columns synthesized fresh each row (PK/UUID); never sampled from reference data. Optional; empty means no identity-column synthesis.

parameters.name: pk_cols
parameters.label: Primary-key columns
parameters.helpText: Comma-separated declared primary-key columns; duplicate PK tuples divert to the DLQ (rule_id=pk.duplicate, BLOCKER). Optional; empty means PK not declared.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.label: Generation engine
parameters.helpText: b1_rag (RAG over reference rows) or b2_library (CTGAN/SDV-family wrapper).

parameters.name: model_uri
parameters.label: Model URI
parameters.helpText: gs://<bucket>/synthetic/models/<family>/<model>/<version>/.

parameters.name: embedder_uri
parameters.label: Embedder URI (B.1 RAG)
parameters.helpText: gs://<bucket>/synthetic/models/embedders/<model>/<version>/ — optional; empty uses the dependency-free HashingEmbedder.

parameters.name: rag_chunks_table
parameters.label: RAG chunk-store table FQN (B.1)
parameters.helpText: project.dataset.table of synthetic_rag.rag_chunks. Enables the read-instead-of-reembed path; with build_rag_layer=true also enables population. Optional; empty disables the chunk store.

parameters.name: build_rag_layer
parameters.label: Populate the RAG chunk store
parameters.helpText: true/false. Populate rag_chunks from this run's reference sample (skipped when the reference_digest already exists for the embedder id+version). Requires rag_chunks_table.

parameters.name: validation_runs_table
parameters.label: validation_runs table FQN
parameters.helpText: Destination BigQuery table for the run-level summary row. project.dataset.table. Optional; empty skips the write.

parameters.name: env
parameters.label: Environment tier
parameters.helpText: dev | uat | prd — selects the threshold tier from config/thresholds.yml.

parameters.name: client_type
parameters.label: Model client type
parameters.helpText: vllm (production), mlx (M4 local smoke), fake (CI fixture).

parameters.name: vllm_dtype
parameters.label: vLLM serve dtype override
parameters.helpText: auto (default) = checkpoint dtype (bf16 for Gemma/Qwen). float16 = explicit downcast REQUIRED on T4 for fp16-safe bf16 checkpoints (Qwen); refused for gemma-family models.

parameters.name: vllm_max_model_len
parameters.label: vLLM max-model-len cap
parameters.helpText: Caps the KV-cache context allocation. Without it vLLM sizes for the checkpoint's native context (Qwen3-2507: 262K needs 36GiB KV and kills the T4 EngineCore at startup). Default 8192 fits every registry model/GPU pairing. Empty = no cap.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.label: Explicit base RNG seed
parameters.helpText: Explicit base RNG seed (integer) for deliberate reproduction of a run. Empty (default) derives a fresh seed per (run_id, batch) — recommended.

parameters.name: write_disposition
parameters.label: Landing write disposition
parameters.helpText: append (default, WRITE_APPEND) or overwrite (WRITE_TRUNCATE). Landing table only; DLQ/quality/RAG tables always append.

parameters.name: create_if_not_exists
parameters.label: Create landing table if missing
parameters.helpText: true/1/yes: CREATE_IF_NEEDED carrying the derived landing schema. Default false (CREATE_NEVER).

parameters.name: freetext_pools_table
parameters.label: Free-text pool store table
parameters.helpText: project.dataset.table of synthetic_rag.freetext_pools. Enables the read-instead-of-rebuild path; with build_pool_layer=true also enables the build branch. Optional; empty disables the pool store.

parameters.name: build_pool_layer
parameters.label: Build the free-text pool store
parameters.helpText: true/false. Build free-text pools in their own branch and persist them (skipped when this reference_digest already exists for this model_uri). Requires freetext_pools_table.

parameters.name: pool_seed_strategy
parameters.label: Free-text pool seed strategy
parameters.helpText: centroid (control, densest region) | kcenter (seeds span the column's modes) | kcenter_rotate (re-seeded per ladder attempt; forfeits vLLM prefix caching by design).
